letters.instructions: Flat hand, four fingers straight up and together, thumb folded across the palm
Fingers and thumb curved into a C, as if holding a cup; palm faces to the side
Index finger points up; the other fingertips touch the thumb tip to form a circle
Index fingertip and thumb tip touch to form a circle; the other three fingers point up, spread
Pinky points up; the other fingers curled, thumb across them
Index points up, thumb points out to the side, forming an L; the other fingers curled
Index, middle and ring fingers up and spread; thumb holds the pinky down
Thumb and pinky out; the other three fingers curled
